tools.description: Create projects, tags or folders in one batch. parent is a folder id (project, folder) or tag id (tag); omit for the root. Optional status (project Active/OnHold/Done, tag Active/OnHold) and sequential (project). Returns one result per item (id, ok/error, name, status, parent); a bad item does not stop the others.

items.description: projects, tags or folders to create, applied in order

parent.description: folder id (project, folder) or tag id (tag); omit for the root

sequential.description: project only: sequential instead of parallel

status.description: project: Active, OnHold, Done; tag: Active, OnHold

tools.name: add

tools.description: Create tasks in one batch. Each task goes to the inbox unless project or parent is given. Returns one result per task (id, ok/error, task record); a bad item does not stop the others.

tasks.description: tasks to create, applied in order

project.description: project id; omit both project and parent for the inbox

tools.name: add_tasks

tools.description: Permanently delete tasks, projects, tags or folders. IRREVERSIBLE. Guards: a tag or folder is deleted only when already dropped and empty (delete children first); a task or project is deleted only without remaining (incomplete) tasks or subtasks; drop it instead. Returns one result per item; a refusal comes back as that item's error with the reason.

items.description: objects to act on, applied in order

tools.name: delete

tools.description: Drop tasks, projects, tags or folders. Reversible through this server only for projects and tags (edit status back to Active); a dropped folder (which also drops its projects) or task cannot be restored through these tools. Dropping a project drops its tasks. Guard enforced by OmniFocus script: a tag is refused while it or any descendant tag has remaining tasks (untag or complete them first). Returns one result per item; a refusal comes back as that item's error.

items.description: objects to act on, applied in order

tools.name: drop

tools.description: Patch projects, tags or folders in one batch: rename; project status Active/OnHold/Done; tag status Active/OnHold; sequential (project); move under a parent id or to the root (parent null); reorder before or after a sibling of the same kind. Folders: rename, move, reorder only. Dropping and deleting are separate tools. Returns one result per item.

items.description: patches applied in order; omitted field = unchanged

move.description: parent: folder id (project, folder), tag id (tag) or null for the root

reorder.description: mutually exclusive with move; the sibling's parent becomes the parent

status.description: project: Active, OnHold, Done; tag: Active, OnHold (Active re-activates a dropped tag); folders have no status edit

tools.name: edit

tools.description: Patch tasks in one batch: name, note, flagged, defer/due/planned (null clears), complete or uncomplete, move to a project, the inbox or a parent task, tags add/remove by id or name. Returns one result per patch (id, ok/error, updated task record).

patches.description: patches applied in order; omitted field = unchanged, null clears note/defer/due/planned

tools.name: edit_tasks

tools.description: Get one folder by id; errors if not found.
tools.name: get_folder

tools.description: Get one project by id; errors if not found.
tools.name: get_project

tools.description: Get one tag by id; errors if not found.
tools.name: get_tag

tools.description: Get one task by id; errors if not found.
tools.name: get_task

tools.description: List folders with parent and status.
tools.name: list_folders

tools.description: List OmniFocus perspectives. Built-in ones have a null id and builtin=true.
tools.name: list_perspectives

tools.description: List projects, optionally filtered by status, folder or search. Limit defaults to 50; null returns all.

folder.description: folder id or exact name; includes subfolders

search.description: case-insensitive substring over name and note

tools.name: list_projects

tools.description: List tags with status and remainingTasks.
tools.name: list_tags

tools.description: List tasks. Filters are AND-combined. Limit defaults to 50; null returns all.

available.description: true: not blocked, deferred, completed or dropped

defer_before.description: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (local time), or RFC 3339 with offset

due_before.description: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (local time), or RFC 3339 with offset

inbox.description: only inbox tasks (true) or only non-inbox tasks (false)

search.description: case-insensitive substring over name and note

tools.name: list_tasks
